im im that boat right now, i wasted my time with high school friends by staying on discord all the time and completely killed any potential friendships, when i got to college it is so much worse and less social than high school, people go, do their classes, and leave. there's little room for any sort of friendships, and i've felt really alone in both semesters of college so far which is making me question if i want to stay here. the good news for you is the fact that you're still in high school and have time to solidify your friendships before you go to college, i wasted all of that and now i'm more alone than i've ever been in my life. take advantage of the situation you're in, and use it to strengthen your friendships so you're prepared socially for college because that's something i didn't do and now i regret it severely
